doc: Idle micro-motion and head lead (M2-HER-1104, ADR 0190): HeroIdleMicro (game/hero_motion/hero_idle_micro.gd), a SkeletonModifier3D layered on whatever clip or pose a hero shows. Degrees, seconds. Breathing and the weight shift scale by the modifier's amount (1 standing, 0 walking or running; it eases between them over amount_fade_sec; HeroMotion.set_locomotion_speed sets it to 0 above still_below_mps m/s). The head lead does not: while the body turns, the neck and head turn ahead of it by lead_sec of the turn speed, capped at max_deg. Each bone list gives a bone and its share of the motion; a bone missing from a rig is skipped.

breath.doc: A slow inhale and exhale: the chest lifts (pitches back) by chest_pitch_deg spread over chest_bones, and the shoulders rise by shoulder_lift_deg. period_sec varies per actor by up to period_spread (a share), so two heroes never breathe in step.

sway.doc: The weight shifting from foot to foot: the hips roll by hips_roll_deg and yaw by hips_yaw_deg about the body, the legs counter the roll so the feet stay planted, and the spine counters it (spine_counter shares, negative = against the hips) so the head stays level.

head_lead.doc: While the body turns at rate r (deg/s), the neck and head turn r * lead_sec ahead of it, at most max_deg, shared across bones. The turn rate is measured from the skeleton's own yaw each frame (smoothed over rate_smoothing_sec) unless a driver sets it.
